title: Research again researches a place from scratch, and the business reading keeps a grounded USP theme by a ladder
steps: S1: Run the research-again plan, research-again and business-reading test files of apps/tracy-web one at a time with --test-concurrency=1 and TEST_DATABASE_URL set.
S2: Run the business-reading-usp-themes and domain-hero-usp test files of packages/wo/website-opportunities.
expect: S1: every test reports ok: a researched place with every source fresh still gets every part in run with reason again, and a Research again from scratch calls the reading model again although the held reading matches its texts and version.

S2: every test reports ok: the ladder keeps two-review themes first, else one-review, else owner words; a quote naming a review-only person drops only that quote; uspThemesDropped records why; the hero accepts one-review and owner themes on their own rung.
evidence: On dev after Research again the logo kept readsAs null from an older pass and the reading kept uspThemes null with uspThemesReason rejected, while the same model and reviews kept a theme locally
fence: The plan's fromScratch branch and the executor's held-reading and logo force on a whole from-scratch run; the ladder in checkUspThemesOf and the basis rungs in checkUspTheme

tests: from scratch, every part runs again whatever its age; only parts this server cannot run are kept
a researched place with every source fresh still gets every part from scratch
a Research again from scratch reads the business again although its texts and version are unchanged
rung 2: with no theme two reviews share, a theme one review states is kept with basis one-review
rung 3: with no review theme, the business's own words carry it, with basis owner
a quote naming a review-only person drops that quote only; the theme stands on what is left
the reading records the dropped themes, and keeps uspThemesReason only when nothing stands
a theme the reading kept on one review or on the business own words passes on its own rung only
